decision: The pretrained floor was measured, not skipped for convenience, and then not re-run.
why_not_rerun: The pretrained base never learned to emit the terminal answer cue, so it generates to the 400-token cap on every record: 2020 ms/record against 130 ms for a finetuned model. Re-confirming a known zero would cost 18.5 h per language (79% of the evaluation budget) and does not fit a Kaggle session.
verdict: EM 0.0000 and format-valid 0.0000 on every slice measured, with no exceptions.
interpretation: A pretrained base that has never seen this output format cannot produce a parseable answer, so ~0 EM is the expected and correct floor. Every finetuned number in RESULTS is a delta against zero.
deviation_from_brief: Part B section 6 asks for the 2 pretrained models to be run through the full matrix. They were run until the floor was unambiguous (15,000 records), then stopped. This is a disclosed deviation, not an omission.
